"Addressing the Gut Microbiota–Immunometabolism Axis in Pediatric Sarcopenic Obesity: The Therapeutic Potential of Dietary Anthocyanins and Microbial Galactose Metabolism". In: *Nutraceuticals* 6:47. DOI: [10.3390/nutraceuticals6030047](https://doi.org/10.3390/nutraceuticals6030047)

Bahena-Delgado AI, Hernandez-Chavez C, Martínez-Medina S, Gil-Martínez G, Canul-Euan AA, Mancilla-Herrera I, Rodríguez-Hernández C, Rojo-Prieto BJ, Rodríguez-Cano AM, Perichart-Perera O, Morales-González J, Estrada-Gutierrez G, Irles C, Medina-Contreras O, Gonzalez-Perez G. (2026). "Immune and body composition signatures of neurodevelopmental impairments in preterm preschoolers" In: *Frontiers in Immunology* DOI: [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1941190](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2026.1941190/abstract)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(RefManageR)

# 1. Load your single references.bib file
bib <- ReadBib("publications.bib")

# 2. Extract a list of all unique years, sorted newest to oldest
years <- sort(unique(unlist(bib$year)), decreasing = TRUE)

# 3. Loop through each year to create headers and list the references
for (y in years) {
  # Print the markdown heading for the year
  cat(paste0("## ", y, "\n\n"))
  
  # Find all references matching this year
  idx <- sapply(bib, function(x) !is.null(x$year) && x$year == y)
  year_refs <- bib[idx]
  
  # Print the formatted references
  print(year_refs, .opts = list(style = "markdown", bib.style = "authoryear"))
  
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
